headline: Nvidia’s Huang Urged Nscale to Move Faster After Early Setbacks
headline_vi: Huang của Nvidia kêu gọi Nscale di chuyển nhanh hơn sau những thất bại ban đầu
summary: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang said he told UK-based neocloud Nscale to “work around the clock” to overcome challenges in bringing some of its data centers online.
